---
title: "Methodology and Conventions"
format: html
---

The engine represents realised returns with negative values for losses and reports VaR
and ES as positive loss magnitudes. Fixed-weight portfolio returns are aggregated in
simple-return space. Rolling forecasts train only through the observation immediately
before the forecast date. VaR, ES, and realised rolling observations are then reported
and compared in `portfolio.return_type` space; the supplied profiles use log returns.
Marginal models must converge and satisfy parameter checks
before diagnostics and information-criterion ranking. Copula tail coefficients are
interpreted on the return-CDF scale.
